policy.review: Every finding needs its source assessment IDs. A teacher reviews the evidence before approval. Guardian release requires a recorded teacher-guardian conversation.
policy.scope: Compare the same learner and skill across dated terms. Describe demonstrated performance on these assessments. Never assign an ability identity, diagnosis, career or subject track. Attendance and notes provide context, not causal explanations.

caveats: These observations describe the supplied assessments and their recorded skill tags.
Different assessment difficulty, missing records and changes in teaching may affect comparisons.
Teachers determine appropriate support through discussion with the learner and guardian.

findings.statement: Recorded reading comprehension assessment averages stayed at or below 45% across 6 terms. Review the source work with the learner to plan support.
Recorded spatial reasoning assessment averages were between 39% and 80% across 6 terms. They do not meet the rubric's sustained high or low thresholds.
